nodes.label: STORY-007 (PRD-004): Centralize user-facing copy in copy.py
Centralized copy module pattern
nodes.rationale: Every user-facing string (bubble labels, PII badge template, footer separators, retry/edit-resend labels, empty state, composer placeholder) is centralized in chat_ui/copy.py so changing display language or wording is a single-file edit; the PII badge copy is required to describe masking as covering 'this exchange' rather than only the user's prompt, and the duplicate-bubble copy must state the text must change for a resend to go through.
